units.source_text: 秋天有一个凄凉的傍晚，夕雾挂念一条院的落叶公主，便前往访问。

en.t: On a bleak autumn evening, Yugiri thought anxiously of Princess Ochiba at Ichijo Palace and went to visit her.

units.source_text: 落叶公主正在随意不拘、从容不迫地弹各种琴。

en.t: Princess Ochiba was at ease, playing various zithers in a relaxed and unstudied way.

units.source_text: 未及好好收拾，侍女们已把夕雾引导到她所居的南厢里来了。

en.t: Before things could be properly put away, the ladies-in-waiting had already led Yugiri into the southern wing where she lived.

units.source_text: 夕雾分明察知室内侍女等膝行而入帘内的情状，听到衣衫窸窣的声音，闻到遗留着的衣香，觉得优雅之趣可爱。

en.t: Yugiri could clearly sense the women inside moving on their knees behind the curtain; hearing the rustle of their garments and smelling the lingering fragrance of their robes, he found the elegant atmosphere charming.

units.source_text: 照例由老夫人出来会面，闲谈种种往事。

en.t: As usual, the elderly lady came out to receive him, and they quietly talked over many things from the past.

units.source_text: 夕雾自己的三条院内，一天到晚有许多人进进出出，非常嘈杂，外加有许多小孩奔走吵闹。

en.t: At Yugiri's own Sanjo residence, people came and went all day long, making it very noisy, and many children ran about shouting as well.

units.source_text: 他在那边住惯了，觉得此地清静可喜。

en.t: Used to living in such a place, he found the quiet here especially pleasing.

units.source_text: 虽然近来不免荒凉之感，毕竟是高贵优雅的住处。

en.t: Although it had lately acquired an unavoidable air of desolation, it was still a noble and graceful residence.

units.source_text: 庭中花木乱开，虫声繁密。

en.t: In the garden, flowering plants bloomed in profusion, and the cries of insects were dense all around.

units.source_text: 夕雾闲眺此夕暮景色，想起秋日的原野。

en.t: Yugiri gazed idly at the evening scene and was reminded of autumn fields.

units.source_text: 便拉过那把和琴来看看，但见弦音合着律调，分明是经常弹奏的，琴上染着奏者的衣香，令人觉得可亲。

en.t: He drew the wagon zither toward him to look at it and found its strings tuned to the proper mode; it had plainly been played often, and the player's robe fragrance clinging to it made it feel intimate.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“在此情景之下，若是个肆无忌惮的色情男儿，会显出不成样子的丑态来，流传可耻的恶名呢！”

en.t: Yugiri thought, "In a situation like this, a shamelessly amorous man would behave disgracefully and earn himself a shameful reputation."

units.source_text: 他一面如此想象，一面试弹和琴。

en.t: Thinking this, he tried playing the wagon zither.

units.source_text: 这是柏木生前常弹的琴。

en.t: It was the zither that Kashiwagi had often played while he was alive.

units.source_text: 夕雾短短地弹了一支富有情趣的乐曲之后，说道：“唉！大纳言弹这琴时，声音真美妙呢！

en.t: After briefly playing a tasteful piece, Yugiri said, "Ah, when the Grand Counselor played this zither, its sound was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 这些妙音一定含蓄在这琴中吧。

en.t: Those wondrous tones must surely still be hidden within this instrument.

units.source_text: 小生拟请公主弹出此种妙音，俾得一饱耳福。”

en.t: I would like to ask the princess to draw out such wondrous sounds, so that I may have the pleasure of hearing them."

units.source_text: 老夫人答道：“自从断弦以来，公主连童年习得的乐曲也忘记得影迹全无了。

en.t: The elderly lady replied, "Since the string broke, the princess has utterly forgotten even the pieces she learned in childhood.

units.source_text: 从前朱雀院命诸公主在御前试弹种种琴筝之时，也曾称赞这位公主弹得不坏。

en.t: In the past, when Retired Emperor Suzaku had the princesses play various zithers before him, he praised this princess too, saying that she played rather well.

units.source_text: 但现在仿佛已经换了一个人，只是茫然若失，忧愁度日，把这琴看作牵惹旧恨的厌物了。”

en.t: But now she seems like a different person, only dazed and forlorn, passing her days in sorrow and regarding this zither as a hateful thing that stirs old grief."

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“这话固然有理，不过‘哀情亦是无常物’呀！”

en.t: Yugiri said, "That is certainly reasonable, but even grief is an impermanent thing."

units.source_text: 他叹息了一会，把琴推向老夫人身边。

en.t: He sighed for a while, then pushed the zither toward the elderly lady.

units.source_text: 老夫人说：“那么就请你试弹一曲，好教我也能辨别此中是否含有妙音，也可使我这因愁闷而昏聩了的耳朵享一下耳福。”

en.t: The elderly lady said, "Then please play a piece yourself, so that I too may tell whether such wondrous tones are hidden in it, and so that these ears of mine, dulled by sorrow, may enjoy a little pleasure."

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“不敢，小生尝闻操琴之道，夫妇之间传承特别真切。

en.t: Yugiri answered, "I would not presume. I have heard that the art of playing the zither is transmitted most truly between husband and wife.

units.source_text: 愿得公主妙手演奏一曲。”

en.t: I wish the princess would play one piece with her marvelous hands."

units.source_text: 便把琴推向帘边，知道公主不会立刻答应，也并不强请。

en.t: He then pushed the zither toward the curtain, knowing that the princess would not agree at once, and did not press her.
